title: ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands

translated_title: ThetreStageAI：面向结构化孟加拉戏剧制作规划的多视图检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 排演一场戏剧演出需要在同一份制作计划中协调台词、演员走位、舞台指示、灯光聚焦、提示时机以及设备限制等多方面因素。本工作提出了 ThetreStageAI，一个用于结构化孟加拉戏剧制作规划的检索增强框架。该系统并非从单一混合语料库中检索，而是维护场景、演员走位和灯光三个独立视图。孟加拉语文本使用 BGE-M3 进行嵌入，并索引到各视图专属的 Qdrant 集合中。检索到的参考资料与制作简报相结合后传递给 Gemini，由其生成符合模式约束的 JSON，其中包含角色、场景、台词、舞台指示、走位、灯光以及可选的音效提示。在接受输出前会进行结构与语义检查，并最多进行一次受限修复尝试。此外，作者还构建了一个由人工引导、大语言模型辅助的合成数据集，包含 500 条简短的孟加拉戏剧记录，该数据集扩展了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 ThetreStageAI，一个通过场景、走位、灯光多视图检索结合模式约束 JSON 生成来实现结构化孟加拉戏剧制作规划的检索增强框架，并配套构建了 500 条记录的人工引导合成数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval-augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning that combines multi-view retrieval (scene, blocking, and lighting) with schema-constrained JSON generation, supported by a human-guided synthetic dataset of 500 records.
